items.q: And then there was another place on Magazine Street. It's called Heavy's, Heavy's Seventh Heaven. ... with George E.

ctx.x: Around 1937. Uh huh. And then there was another place on Magazine Street. It's called Heavy's, Heavy's Seventh Heaven. And Bart smelled the high heaven. Heavy's Seventh Heaven? Yeah, with George E. And then they had the Green Goose on the list. On the, the, the, the name is Creepy. What do you say is Creepy? White Fair, I think. Yeah.
I don't know, I can't pronounce it.
